title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.67
summary: Detect Voscam cameras using ONVIF TCP port 888 in automatic network discovery, authenticated setup and vendor SOAP probing.
changes: Add Voscam ONVIF TCP 888 to camera port definitions, scan defaults and host discovery
Probe real ONVIF SOAP endpoint on open TCP 888 without treating arbitrary open ports as cameras
Preserve existing XAddr and ONVIF setup on port 888
Include TCP 888 at runtime even when existing .env host scan ports were saved before this release
Retain all background-stream, recording, HLS and Compose V2 updater fixes
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.67
description: Add Voscam ONVIF TCP 888 to the camera scanner, host discovery, SOAP verification and camera setup.
releaseNotes: Compatible from 2.20.32. Port 888 is scanned in automatic and manual camera discovery and proven via ONVIF SOAP before declaring a camera. Old .env host-scan lists automatically include 888 in runtime. Camera recordings and other settings are preserved.
